title: Rotational Trajectory Synopsis Groups
summary: We construct finite-dimensional Lie-group summaries of based rotational paths that retain the exact terminal attitude and selected iterated angular-velocity integrals. These summaries, called rotational trajectory synopses, compose exactly under path concatenation. Building on the classical works of Magnus and Chen, we establish endpoint-retaining body, spatial, and hybrid synopsis groups at every finite order and give a uniform matrix realization for the evaluated Magnus hierarchy.
